Questions

Good to know.

How do monthly plans work?
Each Fellow is billed monthly. You can add, remove or upgrade Fellows from the next month, so your crew grows with you.
What's the difference between personal and brand pricing?
Personal plans are for creators, freelancers and personal brands, and cost 15% less. Brand plans are for businesses, shops and startups, where the work usually involves more products, people and approvals.
What is GEO?
GEO stands for generative engine optimisation. More people now ask AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini for recommendations. GEO makes your brand easy for those assistants to find, understand and recommend, through structured data, clear content and mentions on trusted sites.
Is ad spend included in the Social Fellow plan?
No. Your Social Fellow sets up and manages your ad campaigns, but the budget you spend on ads is paid directly to the platform, so you stay in control of it.
Where does the Studio Fellow shoot?
Studio Fellows come to your location for the shoot. Every other Fellow works remotely, so editing, social, web and search plans work wherever you are.
Do I approve content before it goes live?
Yes. Videos, posts and website changes are shared with you for approval first, and each video includes two rounds of revisions.
